caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a woven seat. The chair has a medium brown color, and the wood is carved with turned details on the legs and backrest spindles. The backrest has five slim vertical rods and two thicker outer supports, all connected at the top by a curved crest rail. The woven seat appears tan or straw-colored, with some fraying along the edge. The chair is set against a plain, off-white background. At the bottom left corner of the image, the text "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM." is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Bastard Windsor Chair
